jobs_results.title: Business Intelligence Analyst I
jobs_results.description:
We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Business Intelligence Analyst to join our team in Mumbai. The ideal candidate will have 2-5 years of experience in business intelligence, data analysis, and visualization.


Roles and Responsibility

Develop and implement business intelligence solutions to drive growth and improvement.
Analyze complex data sets to identify trends, patterns, and areas for improvement.
Design and deliver reports, dashboards, and visualizations to stakeholders.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align business strategies with IT initiatives.
Identify and mitigate risks associated with business intelligence projects.
Provide expert guidance on data modeling, ETL processes, and database design.

Job Requirements

Strong understanding of business operations and the ability to analyze complex data sets.
Proficiency in SQL, Excel, or other programming languages.
Experience with business intelligence tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or QlikView.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment.
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

About Company
Teleperformance is a leading provider of customer experience management, offering premier omnichannel support to top global companies. Our diverse service locations, including on-site and work-at-home programs, ensure flexibility and broad reach. We emphasize the importance of our employees, fostering enduring relationships within our teams and communities. Our dedication to employee satisfaction distinguishes us. We utilize advanced support technologies and processes engineered to achieve outstanding results. We cultivate lasting client relationships and make positive contributions to our local communities. Join Teleperformance, where our world-class workforce and innovative solutions drive success.
Experience a workplace that values your development, supports your goals, and celebrates your accomplishments. Be one of our people!


If you have questions or need an accommodation for any disability during this application, please contact your local Teleperformance location for assistance.

jobs_results.title: Data Analyst III
jobs_results.description: About the Company: Ruder Finn is seeking a Senior Data Analyst (Data Analyst III) to join its award-winning Emerging Technology & Analytics team. The chosen candidate will support the agency’s new business efforts by spearheading the research activities such as but not limited to earned media analysis, social listening, influencer identification, data modeling and predictive analytics. This individual will collaborate with several account teams within the agency providing counsel as needed on the various research and analytics needs of the agency’s clients. As Data Analyst III, you will have the opportunity to work alongside the Chief Technology Officer based in New York, NY, on several innovative Consumer, Technology, and Healthcare-related client accounts. The ideal candidate would be a digital native with deep expertise in and a passion for data visualization and storytelling, statistics, web analytics, social media analytics, and the ability to connect the dots back to business objectives. This position will be fully remote, and the working hours will be either 6:00 pm – 3:30 am IST / 8:30 am – 6:00 pm ET or 2:00 pm – 11:00 pm IST / 4:30 am – 1:30 pm ET . Ultimately, your work will help define the business strategy for projects and clients and play a significant role in the growth of the agency. About the Role: If you are motivated by complex, purposeful challenges, this role, with one of the world's largest independent PR and Comms agencies, could be the fit you have been looking for! Job Responsibilities: Collaborate with the global Emerging Technology & Analytics team colleagues in research projects pertaining to new business or client mandates involving sourcing, analysis, and reporting of data and insights tied to the concerned business objectives Deliver market and audience intelligence, including social and digital landscape analysis, audience behavior analysis, sentiment analysis, keyword research, search performance, and competitor analysis including but not limited to share of voice and message pull through Build measurement frameworks, set up searches and dashboards using Boolean queries, and develop client-facing insights and reports Qualifications: Bachelor's Degree in business analytics, computer science, marketing, psychology, or advertising preferred A minimum of 4 years of agency or in-house experience in a data or research analyst role Experience and expertise with writing complex Boolean queries and operating data and media analytics tools such as Cision, Brandwatch, Rival IQ, Meltwater, Signal AI, etc. Expertise in Excel, Google Sheets, Google Analytics and one or more contemporary data visualization platforms (e.g.: Tableau, Power BI, Google Data Studio, etc.) along with SQL Proficiency in AWS, Python, R, and any other statistical computing or functional programming language is a major plus Experience with data modeling and developing custom models is a plus Experience with custom LLMs and working with the contemporary LLMs (e.g. ChatGPT, Bard, etc.) is a plus Excellent problem-solving, creative thinking, general modeling, and data processing skills Strong project management skills, self-starter, ability to adapt and multi-task, and a proven track record of delivering quality and accurate results in a fast-paced and high efficiency agency environment Extremely strong verbal and written English language communication skills

jobs_results.title: Online Data Analyst Jaipur
jobs_results.description:
Job description   

Are you a research-minded individual with a keen eye for detail and a good understanding of national and local geography? This freelance prospect allows you to work at your own pace and from home.   

A day in the life of an online data analyst:   
In this role, you will work on a project that aims to improve the content and quality of digital maps used by people around the world.   
Conduct research and evaluation in a web-based environment, including data verification, comparison, and determining the accuracy and relevance of data.   
Join us today and be part of a agile and innovative team that is making a difference in the world   

TELUS Digital AI Community:   
Our global AI community is a vibrant network of over 1 million participants from diverse backgrounds who collaborate to collect, improve, train, translate, and localize data to build better AI models for our clients. Be part of this growing community and make an impact by supporting the machine learning models used by the world’s largest brands.   

Qualification path   

Qualifications:   
No prior experience is required to apply for this role, but you will need to meet the basic requirements to work on this project and go through a standard assessment process. This is a part time, long-term project, and your work will be subject to quality control checks throughout the duration of this contract.   

Basic Requirements:   
Fluency in reading and writing in Odia and basic proficiency in English.   
A person residing in India for the last 5 years and familiar with Indian business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural content.   
Ability to follow directions and conduct online research using search engines, maps, and website-based information.   
Ability to work with a variety of tasks such as maps, news, audio-related tasks, and relevance.   
Daily broadband internet connection, access to a computer, and required software.

jobs_results.title: Data Analyst (Trainee Remote)
jobs_results.description:
Job Title: Data Analyst Trainee (Remote)


Location: Remote
Job Type: Full-Time / Internship (Trainee)


 About the Role:
We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Data Analyst Trainee to join our dynamic team. This is an excellent opportunity for individuals looking to start or advance their career in data analytics. As a Data Analyst Trainee, you will gain hands-on experience in analyzing and interpreting data, generating reports, and contributing to business insights while working closely with senior data analysts.


 Key Responsibilities:


 Assist in collecting, cleaning, and organizing raw data from various sources.


 Analyze data trends, patterns, and correlations to help make informed business decisions.


 Support in preparing reports, dashboards, and visualizations to communicate findings to key stakeholders.


 Work with data tools and technologies such as Excel, Google Sheets, SQL, or data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, etc.).


 Collaborate with the senior data team to ensure data integrity and accuracy.


 Develop and maintain databases and data systems, ensuring their organization and accessibility.


 Learn and apply analytical methodologies and techniques to improve data-driven decision-making.


 Perform ad hoc analysis and assist in data-related projects as needed.
 Requirements:


 Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Business, or a related field (fresh graduates are encouraged to apply).


 Basic understanding of data analytics concepts and methodologies.


 Familiarity with data analysis tools and techniques (e.g., Excel, SQL, Python, R, etc.).


 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.


 Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks with minimal supervision.


 Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.


 Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.


 A self-motivated learner, eager to develop data analysis skills.


 Ability to work effectively in a remote environment, managing time and priorities efficiently.






Requirements


 Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI.


 Knowledge of statistical analysis techniques.


 Familiarity with programming languages like Python or R for data manipulation.


 Basic understanding of database management and SQL queries.
 Benefits:


 Flexible remote work environment.


 Opportunity to gain hands-on experience and mentorship from experienced professionals.


 Access to training and development resources.


 Opportunity for career advancement based on performance.


 Competitive stipend or salary for trainees.


 Health and wellness benefits (depending on location and eligibility).

jobs_results.title: Data Analyst (Job Vacancy)
jobs_results.description:
The role of 
Data Analyst
 is crucial in driving data-informed decision-making within our team. By leveraging analytical skills and innovative thinking, you will contribute significantly to our strategic goals and enhance our operational efficiency. This position offers a collaborative environment where you can grow your expertise while working alongside talented professionals dedicated to excellence.

As a 
Data Analyst
, you will:


Analyze complex datasets to identify trends and insights that inform business strategies.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand their data needs and provide actionable recommendations.

Develop and maintain dashboards and reports that visualize key performance indicators for stakeholders.

Utilize statistical methods to validate data integrity and ensure accuracy in reporting.

Support data-driven projects by providing analytical expertise and insights throughout the project lifecycle.

Conduct exploratory data analysis to uncover hidden patterns and opportunities for improvement.

Assist in the design and implementation of data collection systems and other strategies to optimize statistical efficiency and data quality.

Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in data analysis to continuously enhance our analytical capabilities.

Mentor junior analysts and contribute to a culture of learning and development within the team.

Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders in a clear and compelling manner, fostering a data-driven culture.


To excel in this role, you should possess the following qualifications and skills:


Proven experience as a Data Analyst or in a similar analytical role.

Strong proficiency in data analysis tools such as SQL, Python, or R.

Experience with data visualization tools like Tableau or Power BI.

Solid understanding of statistical analysis and data modeling techniques.

Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Ability to communicate complex data insights in a clear and concise manner.

Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

Familiarity with database management and data warehousing concepts.

Knowledge of business intelligence principles and practices.

A degree in a relevant field such as Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
